text: Best sourdough in town. The crust is perfect and the staff remember my order.
Waited twenty minutes for a croissant on Saturday morning. The line barely moved.
Lovely cozy room and great coffee, but it gets very loud at lunch.
Ordered ahead online and they still had not started it when I arrived.
Pastries are good but sold out of almond croissants by 10am again.
Friendly barista, spotless tables, and the cardamom bun is unreal.
Weekend wait times are getting worse. Need more people behind the counter.
Good value lunch sandwich. Seating is tight when it is busy.
